novelty.justification: The claim that models maintain an internal “ESSENTIAL/IMMUTABLE” versus “ACCIDENTAL/MUTABLE” tag that “causally gates the model's revision plasticity” proposes a new mechanistic relationship and measurement target in the established study of LLM beliefs. Searches for “LLM essential accidental property internal representation,” “psychological essentialism language model belief revision,” and “activation steering belief mutability resistance” identified the behavioral essentialism work You Are What You're For (2023), human fact-mutability research, and standard internal-direction precedents such as The Geometry of Truth (Marks and Tegmark, 2023), but no prior work directly positing an essence/accident representation separable from truth and causally controlling revision. The step is nevertheless a substantive natural extension combining known behavioral essentialism with established linear probing and steering methods, rather than an entirely new interpretability paradigm, so it fits standard novelty at the upper end.
